summary: Unstable Unicorns is a light, chaotic take-that card game where players race to assemble a stable of seven unicorn cards while using magic, downgrade, and "neigh" cards to sabotage each other. It's fast, silly, and heavily reliant on attacking whoever looks closest to winning.
praised: very easy to teach to casual and non-gamer groups
fast, chaotic fun in short bursts
criticised: heavy take-that can feel mean-spirited or swingy
runaway leader/kingmaking issues in larger groups

interaction.detail: Players directly destroy, steal, or neigh away each other's unicorn cards, so most of the tension comes from attacking whoever is closest to seven unicorns; each player's stable is their own small tableau but it's constantly under threat from everyone else.

subsystems: unicorn army building (playing unicorn cards to your stable while disrupting others)
sources: number of unicorn cards currently in your stable (target 7)
scoring.how_you_win: Draw and play unicorn, magic, and downgrade cards each turn to grow your own stable while sabotaging opponents'; the first player to have 7 unicorns in their stable wins immediately.
